content:
If you haven't yet ordered the iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, you may have to wait until October to receive it. Here's the latest news on iPhone 18 Pro pre-order delivery times.

New iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders are mostly expected to ship in October

Apple opened pre-orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max over the weekend, and a few days after launch, delivery times for most models have been pushed back to October.

The earliest pre-orders will be delivered on Friday, September 18, when Apple Stores will also have the first batch of stock available for purchase.

But as of today, you'll see the following delivery estimates on the US Apple Store:

  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: All colors and storage configurations are scheduled for delivery between October 6 and 13
  • iPhone 18 Pro: All colors and storage configurations are scheduled for delivery between September 29 and October 6

So if you want to buy the iPhone 18 Pro Max, you should expect to wait almost a full month before receiving it.

The situation for the smaller iPhone 18 Pro is slightly better, but unless Apple ramps up production ahead of schedule, you'll likely still have to wait until October to get yours.

It's still too early to know how overall sales of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are shaping up. We also don't know how much impact the smaller flagship model will have on sales this year. But with delivery times already pushed back by several weeks, it does seem to be a positive sign.

Have you pre-ordered the iPhone 18 Pro? Or are you waiting for the iPhone Duo or not planning to upgrade at all? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
